THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Order under Section 4(1)
WHEREAS AN industrial dispute in respect of the matter speciﬁ ed in the statement of the Commissioner General of Labour which accompanies this order exists between,
Mr. C.R.D.Perera, No. 14/13, Samindu Mawatha, Pamunuwila, Gonawala. and
National Building Research Organisation, 99/1, Jawatta Road, Colombo 05.

NOW THEREFORE I, Manusha Nanayakkara, Minister of Labour and foreign Employment do by virtue of the powers vested in me by Section 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon (1956 Revised Edition), as amended by Acts, Nos. 14 of 1957, 4 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 (read with Industrial Disputes-Special Provisions) Act, No. 37 of 1968 hereby appoint, Mr. Ramal I. Siriwardhana, No. 03, Nabili Kotuwa Watta, Gampaha Road, Yakkala. to be the arbitrator and refer the aforesaid dispute to him for settlement by arbitration.
MANUSHA NANAYAKKARA, Minister of Labour and Foreign Employment
Colombo.26th July, 2024.

Mr. C.R.D.Perera, No. 14/13, Samindu Mawatha, Pamunuwila, Gonawala. and
National Building Research Organisation, 99/1, Jawatta Road, Colombo 05.
STATEMENT OF MATTER IN DISPUTE
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is

Whether Mr. C.R.D. Perera Working in th National Building Research Organisation is entitled for the Post of Information Ofﬁ cer and whether he had been caused injustice by not being placed in that service and if so, to what relief he is entitled.

Mrs. A.M.R.C.Attanayaka, No. 385/5, ''Chandi Sewana'', Kongaha Kotuwa, Thanthirimulla, Panadura
and
Rich Colour Exports (Pvt) Ltd, Alubogahawatta, Hirana Thotupola Road, Kidelpitiya, Bandaragama
STATEMENT OF MATTER IN DISPUTE
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is

Whether Mrs. A.M.R.C.Attanayaka Worked at Rich Colour Exports (Pvt) Ltd has been caused injustice by retiring her at the age of 50, when the retirement age mentioned in her appointment letter is 60 years and if so, to what relief she is entitled.
